'''Bitewind Plain''' was a icy plain located in the western reaches of the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Dorn Base power station|power station]] that supplied the nearby [[Dorn Base]] was located in a ravine on the Bitewind Plain.
